test_logic: Every active entity has an extract file for the period, with a row count and control total inside the expected band.
remediation: Chase the entity controller. The period cannot open without the extract.

control_name: Source extract control total agrees to file
test_logic: The control total in the extract header equals the sum of the detail rows after sign normalisation.
remediation: Reject the file and request a re-extract. Never partially load.

test_logic: COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT erp_system, entity, journal_id, line_number) across the staging load.
remediation: Deduplicate on the natural key and re-run. Investigate whether the extract was loaded twice.

test_logic: COUNT(*) = COUNT(DISTINCT entity, account, cost_centre, ic_partner, period, scenario, version, layer) in fact_financials.
remediation: A duplicate grain silently doubles reported results. Fix the load logic; do not deduplicate downstream.

test_logic: After normalisation, every revenue account has a credit balance and every expense account a debit balance at entity level, or the exception is explicitly whitelisted (for example a contra-revenue account).
remediation: Re-check the per-ERP sign rule in erp_source_profile.csv. An inverted sign on one ERP inverts that entity's entire P&L.

test_logic: Every entity has exactly one loaded period per calendar month between its consolidation effective-from date and the current close.
remediation: Investigate whether the entity was acquired or divested mid-period before treating the gap as an error.

test_logic: Kestrel periods 13 to 16 are mapped to December of the fiscal year with adjustment_period_flag = TRUE, and no period 13 to 16 row remains unmapped.
remediation: Special periods are year-end adjustments, not missing months. Mapping them to a thirteenth month breaks every monthly comparison.

test_logic: Every foreign key in every fact resolves to a row in its dimension. No orphan entity, account, cost centre, currency, scenario, version or partner keys.
remediation: Add the missing dimension member or correct the source value. Never create a catch-all 'Unknown' member that hides the problem in reporting.

test_logic: No null amounts or dates after parsing. Kestrel's comma decimal separator and DD.MM.YYYY dates parse correctly against a set of known test values.
remediation: A silently mis-parsed European decimal turns 1.234,56 into 1.23. Fail the load rather than accept nulls.

test_logic: Kestrel eight-character account codes retain their leading zeros. No account code has been coerced to an integer at any stage.
remediation: Enforce a text type on the column at read time and assert the character length.

test_logic: Every source account appearing in the period's postings has an active mapping row to a group account, effective for the posting date.
remediation: Unmapped accounts are held in a suspense layer and reported. They are never defaulted into 'other expenses', which would quietly distort operating expense.

control_name: Mapping targets exist and are active
test_logic: Every group_account referenced in a source mapping exists in group_coa.csv and is active for the period.
remediation: Correct the mapping file. Enforced in CI so a broken mapping cannot be merged.

control_name: No mapping to a statistical account
test_logic: No financial source account maps to an account where is_statistical = TRUE.
remediation: Statistical accounts sit outside the trial balance. Mapping a financial account there would unbalance the entity.

test_logic: Every line whose mapping_type = 'SPLIT' resolves to exactly one group account. No line falls through the rule set without a match.
remediation: Applies especially to Aurora 6100 and Kestrel 00091000 payroll, where the department or cost centre attribute decides whether the cost is a cost of sale or an operating expense. A fall-through silently moves cost across the gross margin line.

control_name: Mapping coverage of value not just of codes
test_logic: The absolute value of mapped postings is at least 99.9% of the absolute value of all postings.
remediation: A single unmapped high-value account can pass a code-count test while failing a value test. Both are run.

test_logic: Report group accounts that received no postings in the period, distinguishing genuinely unused accounts from those expected to be populated.
remediation: Expected for accounts only used by one ERP, for example accrued warranty which Sable entities do not carry.

test_logic: Every mapping change is version controlled with an effective-from date, and no mapping is edited retrospectively for a closed period.
remediation: Retrospective mapping changes silently restate closed periods. Create a new effective-dated row instead.

test_logic: Kestrel accounts 00081000 and 00081200 are reclassified into cost of sales with a sign reversal, and no residual balance remains in the revenue block.
remediation: Leaving the inventory movement in revenue overstates both revenue and gross margin for the German and Dutch entities.

test_logic: Sum of all signed amounts across non-statistical accounts equals zero for each entity and period, in local currency.
remediation: The most fundamental control. A non-zero trial balance means the extract is incomplete or the sign convention is wrong.

test_logic: The mapped trial balance still sums to zero for each entity and period.
remediation: If the source balanced and the mapped version does not, the mapping itself has dropped or duplicated value.

test_logic: The translated USD trial balance sums to zero for each entity and period, once the CTA entry is posted.
remediation: A non-zero USD trial balance with a zero local trial balance is by definition a translation defect, since CTA is the balancing entry.

test_logic: No account where is_statistical = TRUE is included in any trial balance test.
remediation: Including headcount in a debits-equals-credits test produces false failures and trains people to ignore the control.

control_name: Opening balances agree to prior close
test_logic: Every balance sheet account's opening balance equals the prior period's closing balance, in both local and USD.
remediation: Detects retrospective changes to closed periods, which is the most damaging failure mode in a consolidation system.

test_logic: Total assets less total liabilities less total equity equals zero, tested at entity level and at consolidated level.
remediation: Investigate at entity level first. A group-only failure points at a consolidation entry rather than at source data.

control_name: Net income agrees between P&L and balance sheet
test_logic: Net income from the income statement equals the movement in the current-year result equity account.
remediation: A difference means an entry has hit equity directly without passing through the P&L, or the equity roll-forward is broken.

control_name: Cash flow reconciles to the balance sheet
test_logic: Net change in cash from the cash flow statement equals the movement in balance sheet cash and cash equivalents.
remediation: The cash flow statement is derived from balance sheet movements, so a break means a movement has been categorised into no cash flow line or into two.

control_name: Every balance sheet account has a cash flow category
test_logic: Every balance sheet group account has a non-null cash_flow_category, and every non-cash movement is explicitly categorised.
remediation: An uncategorised account causes its movement to vanish from the cash flow statement and breaks CTL-FS-03.

test_logic: Opening retained earnings plus net income attributable to the parent less dividends equals closing retained earnings.
remediation: Detects direct-to-reserves postings, which are a common way for adjustments to bypass the income statement.

test_logic: Every equity account movement is explained by a defined driver: result for the period, contributions, distributions, share-based compensation, CTA or NCI allocation.
remediation: An unexplained equity movement is a suspense item and must be cleared before close.

test_logic: Reported EBITDA computed from the account hierarchy equals revenue less cost of sales less operating expenses, and Adjusted EBITDA equals reported EBITDA plus the sum of accounts flagged as add-backs.
remediation: Guards against the definition drifting between the Excel model, the semantic layer and the board pack.

control_name: Working capital ties to the balance sheet
test_logic: Net working capital reported in the management pack equals the sum of the underlying balance sheet captions.
remediation: Prevents a separately maintained working capital schedule drifting from the accounts.

grain: Currency x period x rate set
test_logic: Every currency in use has an average and a closing rate for every period and every applicable rate set.
remediation: A missing rate silently translates a foreign entity at zero or drops it entirely.

test_logic: Each rate is within 10% of the prior month and within the configured plausible band for the currency pair.
remediation: Catches inverted rates and misplaced decimals before they reach the accounts.

control_name: Translated P&L agrees to the equity result
test_logic: Sum of monthly translated income statement equals the movement in the current-year result account for the entity.
remediation: Enforces that P&L is translated month by month at monthly average rates rather than by applying one rate to a year-to-date total.

test_logic: CTA per the translation engine agrees to an independently computed expectation: opening net assets multiplied by the movement in the closing rate, plus the current-year result multiplied by the difference between closing and average rates.
remediation: CTA must never be entered as a plug. If the independent calculation disagrees, the translation logic is wrong.

test_logic: Every rate is stored as USD per one unit of foreign currency and falls inside the configured band for that currency.
remediation: An inverted EUR rate of 0.92 instead of 1.09 understates a German entity by roughly 30% and is not obvious in a summary review.

test_logic: No downstream calculation reads Kestrel's legacy EUR group-currency column or Aurora's system-translated USD column.
remediation: Translating an already-translated amount produces a triangulated rate error that is very hard to find later. Translate only from local currency.

test_logic: The budget rate set for a locked version is byte-identical to the set stamped at approval.
remediation: Restating budget FX destroys accountability for the variance.

test_logic: Reported USD less constant-currency USD equals the FX impact reported in the revenue and EBITDA bridges.
remediation: Ensures the FX column in the bridge is calculated rather than asserted.

grain: Entity pair x account x period
test_logic: For every entity pair, intercompany receivables of one side equal intercompany payables of the other after translation at the common closing rate.
remediation: Investigate genuine differences (timing, disputes, FX on differing currencies) before writing anything off.

control_name: Intercompany profit and loss eliminates to nil
grain: Entity pair x account x period
test_logic: Intercompany revenue equals intercompany cost of sales or expense for every pair and period after translation at the monthly average rate.
remediation: A break usually means a cut-off difference where the two sides recorded the transaction in different months.

test_logic: No unreconciled intercompany difference is older than sixty days, and the total unmatched balance is below the configured threshold.
remediation: Ageing surfaces chronic mismatches, which is what actually goes wrong in practice, rather than a single month's timing noise.

test_logic: Every posting to an account where is_intercompany = TRUE carries a valid intercompany partner that is not the posting entity itself.
remediation: Without a partner the balance cannot be matched. Self-referencing partners indicate an incorrectly coded journal.

test_logic: Interest on affiliate loans is mapped to the intercompany interest accounts and not left in the third-party interest accounts.
remediation: Relevant to Kestrel account 00100000, which does not separate the two. Un-eliminated intercompany interest overstates consolidated net interest and distorts the covenant coverage ratio.

test_logic: Total debits equal total credits within each elimination entity for each period.
remediation: A one-sided elimination unbalances the group balance sheet.

test_logic: Consolidated balances on all accounts where is_intercompany = TRUE are nil, except for the unrealised profit in inventory account which is intended to carry a balance.
remediation: The exception is deliberate: unrealised profit is a real consolidation adjustment, not an elimination.

test_logic: Unrealised profit equals intercompany inventory held at period end multiplied by the transfer margin, and is allocated between group and non-controlling interests where the holder is not wholly owned.
remediation: Frequently missed. Omitting it overstates consolidated inventory and gross profit.

test_logic: Ownership plus non-controlling interest equals 100% for every consolidated entity, and every entity except the ultimate parent has exactly one parent.
remediation: Prevents double-counting or omission of a subsidiary in the consolidation tree.

test_logic: No entity contributes results for a period before its consolidation effective-from date or after its effective-to date.
remediation: Consolidating Halden from January 2023 rather than April 2023 would overstate FY2023 revenue by roughly six million dollars and corrupt the organic growth bridge.

test_logic: Consolidated investment in subsidiary is nil, and the elimination against the subsidiary's share capital and pre-acquisition reserves balances.
remediation: Walk the full ownership tree; second-tier holdings are the usual failure point.

test_logic: NCI share of net income equals the NCI percentage multiplied by the subsidiary's net income, and closing NCI equity equals opening plus share of result less dividends plus the NCI share of the CTA movement.
remediation: Tests both the income statement allocation and the balance sheet roll-forward.

control_name: Consolidated result reconciles to the sum of parts
test_logic: Consolidated net income equals the sum of entity net income, plus eliminations, plus consolidation adjustments. Each reconciling item is separately identified.
remediation: This is the reconciliation a CFO will ask for first, so it is produced automatically rather than on request.

test_logic: The statutory consolidated result excludes the management adjustment layer entirely, and the management view equals the statutory result plus that layer.
remediation: Prevents normalisation entries leaking into the reported result.

test_logic: Every consolidation and management adjustment has an adjustment ID, type, preparer, approver, narrative and reversal flag. Nothing is posted anonymously.
remediation: Auditability is the whole point of separating the adjustment layer.

test_logic: Every adjustment flagged as reversing has a matching reversal in the following period.
remediation: Unreversed accruals are a classic source of drift between the management and statutory views.

test_logic: Budget and the current forecast version exist for every entity and every month of the fiscal year in scope.
remediation: A missing entity in the budget makes every variance for that entity equal to the full actual, which reads as a catastrophic overspend.

control_name: Forecast actual months agree to Actual
test_logic: For a forecast version, the months flagged as actual are identical to the Actual scenario for the same entity and period.
remediation: An 8+4 forecast whose first eight months disagree with actuals is not a forecast.

test_logic: No row changes in a locked budget version after its approval date.
remediation: Enforced by hashing the version at lock and comparing on every build.

test_logic: Budget and forecast use the same entity, account and cost centre members as Actual, with no scenario-only members.
remediation: Scenario-only members produce variance rows with no actual counterpart, which look like errors to a reader.

test_logic: Prior year computed by date offset equals the Actual scenario for the corresponding period of the prior year.
remediation: Confirms that the derived prior-year approach is equivalent to storing it.

test_logic: A single statement reconciles the sum of source-system trial balances to the consolidated result, showing mapping effects, translation, eliminations, consolidation adjustments and management adjustments as separate reconciling lines.
remediation: The headline auditability deliverable. Every difference between what the ERPs say and what the board sees is named and quantified.

control_name: Revenue detail ties to the general ledger
test_logic: Revenue in the customer and product detail fact equals revenue on the corresponding general ledger accounts.
remediation: Revenue analytics is built on the detail fact, so a break means the analytics and the accounts tell different stories.

control_name: Headcount ties between statistical and HR data
test_logic: Period-end FTE in the statistical accounts equals the headcount fact within a tolerance for timing.
remediation: Keeps per-FTE metrics defensible.

test_logic: Capital additions in the capex fact equal the movement in gross property, plant and equipment less disposals and FX.
remediation: Detects capex reported to the board that never reached the balance sheet.

control_name: Debt schedule ties to the balance sheet
test_logic: Closing balances in the debt schedule equal the debt captions on the balance sheet, and interest expense in the schedule equals the interest accounts.
remediation: Covenant reporting is calculated from the schedule; it must agree with the accounts.

test_logic: Generated and consolidated results agree with the Phase 1 financial anchors: revenue, EBITDA and net income within 0.5%, balance sheet captions within 1.0%.
remediation: The synthetic data exists to tell a specific business story. Drift from the anchors means the generators, not the anchors, need correcting.

control_name: Gross margin within a plausible band
test_logic: Gross margin by business unit is within eight percentage points of the trailing twelve-month average, or an explanation is recorded.
remediation: Catches cost-of-sales mapping errors that a balancing control cannot see because they net within the P&L.

test_logic: Revenue per FTE is within 25% of the trailing twelve-month average for the entity.
remediation: Detects headcount or revenue loaded for the wrong entity.

test_logic: Accounts flag when they carry a balance opposite to their normal balance: negative inventory, negative cash, debit-balance revenue.
remediation: Often legitimate but always worth a look; a credit balance in accounts receivable usually means unapplied cash.

test_logic: DSO, DIO and DPO are within fifteen days of the trailing twelve-month average.
remediation: A step change in DSO with no change in revenue usually indicates a cut-off or an unposted cash receipt.

test_logic: Absolute percentage error of each closed forecast version against actuals is computed and trended by business unit.
remediation: Makes forecast quality visible and holds forecast owners accountable over time.

test_logic: Every fact row carries a layer_id present in config/dimensions/consolidation_layer.csv. No null, no zero, and no value outside the defined set of 1-5. The set of layers materialised into dim_layer matches the configuration file exactly - no extra members, none missing.
remediation: An undefined layer silently excludes rows from both the statutory and the management view, because both are defined by explicit layer membership. The row is neither reported nor flagged as missing. Reject the load and correct the engine that produced it.

control_name: Ownership percentage effective for the period
test_logic: The ownership and NCI percentages applied when consolidating an entity for a period are those effective for that period in ownership_history.csv. Exactly one ownership row is effective for each entity and period; ownership plus NCI equals 100%.
remediation: Applying a current ownership percentage to a historical period restates history. Overlapping or missing effective-date ranges are a configuration error and block the period.

test_logic: Closing NCI equity equals opening NCI (340100) plus share of result (340200) less dividends and distributions (340300) plus share of translation adjustment (340400) plus acquisition and ownership changes (340500). Opening NCI equals the prior period closing NCI in USD, never retranslated.
remediation: Tests the complete roll-forward rather than only the income allocation. The component most often omitted is the NCI share of the CTA movement, which quietly overstates group equity and understates NCI.

control_name: Non-controlling interest share of consolidation adjustments
test_logic: Where a consolidation adjustment relates to a partially owned subsidiary, the non-controlling share is allocated to NCI rather than borne wholly by the group. Applies to unrealised profit in inventory held by NIG-510 and to any purchase-price-allocation amortisation attributable to it.
remediation: Allocating 100% of an adjustment on an 80%-owned subsidiary to the group is a real and easily missed error. Recompute the allocation using the ownership percentage effective for the period.

control_name: Non-controlling interest distributions presented in financing
test_logic: Dividends and distributions to non-controlling interests (340300) are presented as a financing cash outflow in the consolidated cash flow statement, never within operating activities.
remediation: A distribution to a minority holder is a return of capital to an owner, not an operating cost. Misclassifying it overstates operating cash flow and free cash flow.

test_logic: Closing CTA equals opening CTA (330100) plus the period movement (330200) plus any amount recycled on disposal (330300). The closing CTA of each period equals the opening CTA of the next, per entity, with no unexplained step. While no disposal is in scope, 330300 is nil in every period.
remediation: A discontinuity in the CTA roll-forward means either that a prior period has been restated or that the translation engine has recomputed CTA from scratch instead of rolling it forward. Both are defects.

test_logic: An acquired entity's opening balance sheet is translated at the spot rate on its consolidation effective date, that translated equity is frozen as the historical base, and the entity's opening CTA is nil in its first consolidated period. Goodwill and acquired intangibles are recorded in the entity's functional currency and translate at closing rates thereafter.
remediation: Holding foreign goodwill flat in USD instead of translating it is a common error that suppresses genuine CTA movement. Applies to NIG-220 (2023-04-01) and NIG-410 (2024-07-01).

control_name: Cash flow FX effect correctly split
test_logic: The translation effect is split between the effect on foreign-currency cash balances, presented below financing activities, and the non-cash translation movement on other working capital, presented as a reconciling item within operating activities. The two components sum to the total translation effect on non-equity balances.
remediation: Routing the entire CTA movement through the cash line produces an implausible FX effect on cash while the statement still ties. This was a defect corrected in Phase 1 and the control exists so it cannot recur.

control_name: Net income attributable to parent and NCI
test_logic: Total consolidated net income equals net income attributable to the group plus net income attributable to non-controlling interests (850100). The P&L allocation line (850100) equals the equity credit to NCI share of result (340200) for the same period.
remediation: Links the income statement allocation to the equity roll-forward. A difference means the two were computed independently rather than from one entry.

test_logic: Versions flagged as reserved or unapproved, including the Downside scenario, are excluded from every default reporting view and from the base dataset. They appear only where a user explicitly selects them.
remediation: A downside scenario that leaks into the default view misstates the reported position. Reserved versions carry is_reserved = TRUE and are filtered at the mart layer, not at the visual.

test_logic: The translation engine's CTA for each foreign entity and period equals the expectation published at source in data/reference/cta_expectation.csv, which is computed from the entity's own net assets, its result and the approved rate file alone. The group figure additionally carries the retranslation of goodwill and acquired intangibles, and is reduced by the non-controlling interest's share and the movement in unrealised intercompany profit.
remediation: This is what makes CTL-FX-04 testable rather than aspirational: there is now an independently generated figure to test against, produced before the engine existed and derived from no group target. See ADR-0017.

control_name: No residual or balancing account in any layer
test_logic: No account in any chart, and no posting in any layer, exists to absorb a difference between a computed result and an expected one. Equity closes on its roll-forward: opening plus result plus contributions less distributions plus the computed CTA. Any account whose name or use identifies it as a measurement reserve, balancing entry, residual, plug or group true-up fails the control.
remediation: A consolidation that balances because something was made to absorb the difference proves nothing. Phase 2.0 absorbed a residual into investment at cost and Phase 2.1 into a named equity reserve; both were removed in Phase 2.2 once the layer-1 equity bridge was derived (ADR-0016 superseded by ADR-0017). This control exists so neither can recur.

control_name: Facility charge supported by the daily drawn balance
test_logic: For each revolving facility: opening drawn plus drawings less repayments equals closing drawn; and the average daily drawn balance multiplied by the applicable base rate plus margin, plus the commitment fee on the average daily undrawn commitment, equals the recorded facility charge for the period.
remediation: Interest accrues on a daily balance, not a month-end one. An average-drawn assumption that the facility's own roll-forward contradicts is how a leveraged group misstates its interest cost and its covenant coverage at the same time. See ADR-0018 and config/debt/treasury_policy.csv.
